intro: You wake up on the cold floor of a locked library. There is a desk with a drawer, a bookshelf, a painting and a heavy door with a four-digit keypad. Find the clues and escape!

desk.examine: A wooden desk with a notebook, a locked drawer and a single lit candle. You count exactly one candle.

bookshelf.examine: Most books are neatly aligned, but four stand out, tilted against the rest. Inside their covers are handwritten digits: 3, 7, 1 and 9.

painting.examine: A painting of a grandfather clock. Its hands point to 4:25.

drawer.examine_locked: A small drawer in the desk with a four-digit keypad. It is locked.
drawer.examine_open: The drawer is open. A folded note lies inside.
drawer.examine_open_empty: The drawer is open and empty.

door.examine: A heavy wooden door with a four-digit keypad. It is locked.

note.text: Door code: the time in the painting, then the candles on the desk.
